lines: d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ji Sokolov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d32: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d32: 🕯️ Ji Sokolov is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d32: What Ji kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d32: "Ji's gone." Victor looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ji." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d32: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Danylo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d32: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d32: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Ji Sokolov, 32 days. The mantle passes to Danylo Doroshenko.
d32: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Danylo Doroshenko, 29 — a comic shop owner. His hands know different work now: The Touch, Bloodhound.
d32: The village's quarrel was with Ji — and Ji is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d32: At the grave, Victor, Olivia speak for Danylo — "Ji trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d32: The fire knew Danylo before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
